title: Normalized scalar tensor comparison and recorded compact-support identification
statement:
Let $W$ be a scheme and $a:R\to S$ a morphism of commutative ring sheaves on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the actual universal derived scalar extension [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower] and chosen tensor models with their flat-term K-flat representative identifications [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. The ordinary scalar/tensor isomorphism sends $s\otimes(m\otimes n)$ to $(s\otimes m)\otimes(1\otimes n)$, naturally in both modules. Define scalarTensorTotal to be the signed total comparison from the tensor of the two extended complexes to the extension of their tensor total; it is invertible. Define scalarTensor to be the unique natural derived balancing isomorphism from scalar extension after the source tensor to target tensor after the two scalar extensions. On every pair of flat-term K-flat complexes, its composite with the two universal scalar counits, after the source representative identification, equals the tensor-complex scalar counit followed by the localization of the inverse scalarTensorTotal and then the target representative identification. No flatness of $a$ is assumed.

For the second construction fix a finite-field datum $D$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(D)$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a separated finite-type morphism $f:X\to Y$ between separated finite-type schemes over $\operatorname{Spec}\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, with a compactification $c$ [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. On the uniform finite-Tor integral constructible category, define recordedSupport to be its inclusion [def-sf-finite-tor-integral-inclusion], followed by the recorded completed compact-support functor and its ambient inclusion [def-sf-operation-stages]. Define IsRecordedIdentification for a natural isomorphism from the ambient ringed $Rp_*j_!$ functor on that domain to recordedSupport by the following equation for every input $M$ and every $n\geq0$: reduction of its component followed by the recorded compact-support reduction identification equals finiteReductionIso inverse, then the actual proper/open scalar mate for integral reduction [def-sp-coefficient-mate-comparisons], then finiteImageIso, then finite compact support applied to finiteReductionIso at $X$ [def-pur-finite-compact-support-scalar-data]. Define recordedIdentification to be the unique natural isomorphism satisfying this normalization against the fixed Roos projections. Existence and uniqueness refer to these prescribed strict-tower comparison data, not to unrestricted maps with equal finite reductions.
